subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers continue with this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after repair, or route the issue to another refreshed candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping open candidate work, this PR still has blocking proof and code findings, and automation should not choose the canonical branch or waive real behavior proof.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, conflict/mergeability refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the member candidate after refresh
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive live proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source-level proof, but the predicate and metadata blockers still need repair before merge.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require the narrower predicate, metadata preservation, conflict/mergeability refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent media/action plumbing history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the canonical-fix choice.
